stories.title: Muse Glimmer from Meta Superintelligence Labs is now available
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Meta has released Muse Glimmer, its first open model from Meta Superintelligence Labs.
Muse Glimmer is a 30B multimodal model licensed under Apache 2.0, targeting local coding agents.
The model is optimized for local deployment via Ollama, featuring new DFlash and image input support.

stories.title: Gemini's Personal Intelligence is coming to cars
stories.author: Ryan Whitwam
bullet_points: Google's Gemini AI is being integrated into automotive systems.
This signals a major shift towards personalized, in-car AI experiences.
The article advises users to review their Gemini privacy and settings.

stories.title: Quantum error correction goes well beyond breakeven
stories.author: John Timmer
bullet_points: Demonstration shows quantum error correction is highly effective.
Error rates decrease significantly as the number of qubits increases.
This suggests a major step toward scalable, fault-tolerant quantum computing.

stories.title: OpenVLHarness: Real World Visual Agentic Tool-Use with Multimodal Memory
stories.author: Kai-Wei Chang
bullet_points: Introduces OpenVLHarness, a framework for real-world visual agentic tool-use with multimodal memory.
Addresses the limitation of current Multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) where internal reasoning is insufficient for tasks requiring external evidence.
Demonstrates that simple increases in model inference budget yield only modest gains, highlighting the need for grounded perception and tool integration.

stories.title: Text-to-Image Generative Modeling Without Language Pretraining
stories.author: Michael Poli
bullet_points: Introduces Halcyon, a new family of multimodal autoregressive models for text-to-image generation that bypasses the need for large-scale language pretraining.
Halcyon-0.52B demonstrates superior performance (48.0 vs 63.3 gFD) compared to LlamaGen-XL/8 while requiring 18.2x less pretraining compute.
The research suggests that strong T2I generation can be achieved by training entirely from scratch on a curated dataset (GPIC), challenging the current reliance on massive language models.

stories.title: OpenVLHarness: Real World Visual Agentic Tool-Use with Multimodal Memory
stories.author: Kai-Wei Chang
bullet_points: Introduces OpenVLHarness, a system designed for real-world visual agentic tool-use.
Addresses the limitation of current Multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) where internal reasoning is insufficient for complex tasks.
Demonstrates that achieving better performance requires grounding perception and using external tools whose outputs are made interpretable to the model.

stories.title: OpenVLHarness: Real World Visual Agentic Tool-Use with Multimodal Memory
stories.author: Kai-Wei Chang
bullet_points: Introduces OpenVLHarness, a system designed for real-world visual agentic tool-use.
Addresses the limitation of current Multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) where internal reasoning is insufficient for tasks requiring external evidence.
Demonstrates that achieving performance gains requires grounding perception and utilizing heterogeneous tools, not just increasing model inference budget.

stories.title: Google open-sources TorchTPU, a native PyTorch back end for TPUs
stories.author: ilreb
bullet_points: Google has open-sourced TorchTPU, a native PyTorch backend designed for Google's TPUs.
This release aims to improve the accessibility and integration of PyTorch workflows on TPU hardware.
The open-sourcing of this tool is a significant step in democratizing advanced ML infrastructure.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights a trending model, deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1, on Hugging Face Benchmarks.
The model is categorized for text generation and conversational AI tasks.
It utilizes standard ML components like transformers and safetensors.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model on Hugging Face Benchmarks.
It pertains to the text-generation pipeline, indicating its application in large language model tasks.
The associated tags confirm its relevance within the transformer and Llama ecosystem.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Meta-Llama-3-8B model on Hugging Face.
It is categorized under text-generation, indicating its primary function as a large language model.
The associated tags (transformers, safetensors, llama) confirm its relevance within the modern NLP/AI ecosystem.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is now accessible via Ollama.
It is a 30 billion parameter open model optimized for agentic workflows.
The model is designed for local hardware execution, supporting multi-step tasks and tool calling.

stories.title: Ollama: all aboard open models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a platform for running open models, has secured significant funding.
The company raised $88 million from prominent investors including Y Combinator and Benchmark.
Ollama is currently serving a large developer base of 8.9 million users.

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Gemma 4 inference speed is significantly improved within Ollama 0.31 on Apple Silicon.
The performance boost is achieved through the implementation of Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) powered by MLX.
Coding agent performance shows up to a 90% speed increase when benchmarked using Aider.

stories.title: SpaceX says big AI growth fueled revenue jump
stories.author: Jay Peters
bullet_points: SpaceX reported a massive 161% year-over-year revenue jump in Q3, reaching $14.6 billion.
The revenue growth is explicitly attributed to the 'Super Intelligence (SI) segment' and accelerated Connectivity growth.
While the Space division incurred a loss, the Connectivity group generated a positive income from operations.

stories.title: Meta drops the word "train" from its commercial TOS after AI backlash
stories.author: Ashley Belanger
bullet_points: Meta has modified its commercial Terms of Service (TOS) by removing the term 'train' in relation to AI data usage.
The policy change addresses backlash concerning AI scraping practices.
Crucially, Meta has opted not to implement language that respects robots.txt directives.

stories.title: The Internet goes on high alert after discovery of 8 compromised TLS certs
stories.author: Dan Goodin
bullet_points: Discovery of 8 compromised TLS certificates poses a significant security threat to the internet.
The vulnerability stems from intermediate certificates, which allow unauthorized parties to mint web credentials.
This flaw potentially enables attackers to impersonate or compromise any internet server.

stories.title: LatComm: Reusable Context Compression for Latent Communication between Large Language Models
stories.author: Weijie Zhao
bullet_points: LatComm addresses the inefficiency of passing large, redundant contexts between multiple LLMs.
It introduces a method for creating a compact, reusable context representation readable by different LLMs.
The research aims to reduce computational overhead associated with repeated token processing in multi-LLM systems.

stories.title: Same Simulation, Different Evidence: Where Retrieved Tool Output Costs LLM Agents Accuracy
stories.author: Maziar Raissi
bullet_points: Investigates how storing long tool outputs (like from scientific simulators) outside the LLM context window impacts agent accuracy.
Uses the PHREEQC geochemistry simulator, a deterministic tool, to test agents on 158 execution-verified questions.
Highlights a critical challenge in LLM agent design: even correct computation can lead to wrong answers due to context management overhead.

stories.title: Agent World Model in the Wild: Computer-Use Agent Environment Synthesis
stories.author: Huaxiu Yao
bullet_points: Introduces WildAWM, a pipeline for synthesizing controllable environments to train general computer-use agents (CUAs).
Addresses the challenge of scaling agent learning from human data to real-world interaction while mitigating security risks.
Represents a shift in AI research toward interaction-based learning rather than solely relying on pre-existing human datasets.

stories.title: MemT-1.0: Towards Memory-Native Evolution
stories.author: Feiyu Xiong
bullet_points: Introduces MemT-1.0, a new architecture for memory foundation models designed to internalize memory as a core computational capability.
Employs Gated DeltaNet-2 and a stable token-level memory update mechanism to enable continuous information accumulation.
Scales native memory capacity through the introduction of a Mixture-of-Storage mechanism.

stories.title: Claude designed protein binders against scorpion neurotoxins
stories.author: artninja1988
bullet_points: Claude AI was used to design protein binders.
The binders are specifically targeted against scorpion neurotoxins.
This represents a significant application of large language models in biotechnology/drug discovery.

stories.title: Automated incident triage on GKE with Gemini 4 Argon and Model Context Protocol: Correlating cluster events and VPA logs
stories.author: olivi-eh
bullet_points: Introduces automated incident triage for Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) using advanced AI.
Leverages Gemini 4 Argon for multi-step reasoning to correlate complex cluster events and VPA logs.
Utilizes the GKE Model Context Protocol server to provide necessary context for the AI analysis.

stories.title: Clef is available on Ollama's cloud
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Clef, a 27B multimodal decision model from Cloudflare, is now integrated with Ollama.
Users have the option to run the Clef model either locally or via Ollama's cloud infrastructure.
This integration expands the capabilities of Ollama by adding a powerful, large-scale multimodal model.

stories.title: Reflection's Beam is freely available on Ollama for a limited time
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Reflection's open-weight model, Beam, is now accessible via Ollama.
Beam is specifically designed for software engineering, reasoning, and agentic tasks.
The model is available for free for a limited promotional period through Ollama Cloud.

stories.title: Run AI agents safely with Ollama and Fly.io
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama enables the deployment of AI agents using its cloud models.
The integration allows these AI agents to run safely within Fly.io's cloud infrastructure.
This combination addresses the need for secure and accessible deployment of AI agents.

stories.title: Ollama now supports Jev-style decision models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has integrated support for Jev-style decision models via TypeSafe's Jev API.
These new models enable fast, low-latency, and cost-free decision-making based on text input.
The models provide probabilistic answers to yes/no questions, choices, and scoring.

stories.title: Claude Desktop support with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Claude Desktop now supports Ollama as a third-party gateway.
This integration allows users to run open-source models within the Claude Desktop environment.
It bridges proprietary AI platforms with local, open-source LLM ecosystems.

stories.title: Netflix is telling investors not to worry, even though you’re watching less and less
stories.author: Emma Roth
bullet_points: Netflix is prioritizing monetization strategies despite reports of declining viewing time.
The company highlighted monetization improvements as a key focus in its recent earnings report.
Future efforts will also involve boosting entertainment value and leveraging new technology.

stories.title: Oura adds two new cardiovascular health tracking features to its smart rings
stories.author: Andrew Liszewski
bullet_points: Oura is enhancing its smart ring capabilities with new cardiovascular health tracking features.
The new features include 'Cardio Effort' and automatic VO2 Max tracking.
The updates aim to help users optimize their exercise routines for long-term health.

stories.title: Xbox CEO is reportedly planning three more rounds of layoffs
stories.author: Jay Peters
bullet_points: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma is reportedly planning additional rounds of layoffs in November and January.
These new cuts follow previous layoff announcements made in July and September.
The ongoing restructuring is part of a broader organizational 'reset' within Microsoft.

stories.title: Ukraine’s drone rescue of wounded soldier puts much touted idea into practice
stories.author: Jeremy Hsu
bullet_points: Ukraine is utilizing drone technology for the rescue and evacuation of wounded soldiers.
This application demonstrates a practical use case for advanced drone capabilities in conflict zones.
The innovation has the potential to significantly improve casualty evacuation odds.

stories.title: Meta tries to scapegoat staff who downloaded torrents to spare execs
stories.author: Ashley Belanger
bullet_points: Meta is facing scrutiny over the use of copyrighted material (books) in its AI training data.
The company is attempting to shift blame onto individual employees who downloaded torrents, rather than systemic policy.
This incident highlights ongoing legal and ethical debates surrounding data scraping and intellectual property in large-scale AI development.

stories.title: CoopUQ: Robust Multi-Robot Social Navigation via Uncertainty-Aware Cooperative Forecasting
stories.author: Jiachen Li
bullet_points: Introduces CoopUQ, a method for robust multi-robot social navigation using reinforcement learning.
Addresses limitations of single-robot approaches in multi-robot systems, particularly concerning safety and efficiency.
Focuses on handling challenging real-world scenarios like occlusions and out-of-distribution (OOD) predictions through cooperative forecasting.

stories.title: Where is Physical RSI capability from? An Observational Scaling Law of LLM-as-policy
stories.author: Li Yi
bullet_points: The paper investigates the mechanisms and scaling behavior of 'physical Recursive self-improvement' (RSI) in Large Language Models (LLMs) acting as policies.
A new evaluation framework, PhysRSI-eval, is introduced to quantify physical RSI using a five-axis metric (Performance, Efficiency, Success, Budget, Improvement from failure).
The research tests various Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on 18 manipulation tasks, leading to the proposal of the 'Physical Barrel Hypothesis'.

stories.title: WeAct: Dynamic Weight Switching as Agent Actions
stories.author: Shuyan Zhou
bullet_points: Addresses catastrophic forgetting in long-horizon AI agents that need diverse capabilities.
Introduces WeAct (Weight-level Internal Actions) to dynamically switch between specialized model weights during execution.
Overcomes limitations of conventional joint training and static adapter merging by allowing parameter configuration changes mid-trajectory.

stories.title: Train An Imaginative Agent
stories.author: Haiwen Feng
bullet_points: Introduces 'Agentic Imagination' (Agima), a new training framework for AI agents.
Agima enables agents to 'imagine' the outcomes of their actions before executing them.
This capability is crucial for solving complex problems where environmental feedback is sparse or actions are irreversible (e.g., in Sokoban).

stories.title: AnyGoal: On World Model Generalization Beyond Expert Rollouts
stories.author: David Klindt
bullet_points: The research focuses on improving World Models, which aim to capture environmental dynamics for agent planning.
A key challenge addressed is ensuring learned dynamics generalize reliably beyond the specific data seen during expert training.
The study investigates the underexplored relationship between data coverage, dynamics generalization, and planning performance.

stories.title: Kronecker Delta Rule for Long Context Linear Attention
stories.author: Sepp Hochreiter
bullet_points: Introduces KronLSTM, a new linear attention architecture leveraging the Kronecker Delta Rule.
KronLSTM features a memory-revision mechanism that corrects targeted associations minimally.
This design aims to reduce interference in memory storage, making it suitable for long-context processing.

stories.title: CoopUQ: Robust Multi-Robot Social Navigation via Uncertainty-Aware Cooperative Forecasting
stories.author: Jiachen Li
bullet_points: Addresses the limitations of single-robot reinforcement learning when scaled to multi-robot systems.
Proposes 'CoopUQ' to enhance social navigation robustness in human-shared environments.
Focuses on using uncertainty-aware cooperative forecasting to handle occlusions and out-of-distribution (OOD) risks.

stories.title: WeAct: Dynamic Weight Switching as Agent Actions
stories.author: Shuyan Zhou
bullet_points: Addresses catastrophic forgetting in long-horizon AI agents that need diverse capabilities.
Introduces WeAct (Weight-level Internal Actions) to dynamically switch between independent capabilities during execution.
Overcomes limitations of static parameter configurations by allowing the agent to select specialized weights as part of its action.

stories.title: Supervised Learning with Quantum Hamiltonian Embeddings
stories.author: Kunal Sharma
bullet_points: Introduces 'quantum Hamiltonian embeddings' as a novel supervised learning framework.
Aims to bridge the gap between classical ML data and quantum computation by encoding data into a parameterized Hamiltonian.
Addresses the current limitation of general quantum machine learning models lacking provable performance guarantees.

stories.title: Can It Actually Work? Synthesizing Functional CAD Mechanisms
stories.author: Zhen Liu
bullet_points: LLM agents can generate visually plausible CAD designs, but these designs often lack functional validity.
The research focuses on 'functional CAD design,' requiring agents to build and iteratively refine mechanisms based on physical requirements.
Verifying functional requirements is complex because multiple distinct designs can achieve the same intended function.

stories.title: WeAct: Dynamic Weight Switching as Agent Actions
stories.author: Shuyan Zhou
bullet_points: Addresses catastrophic forgetting in long-horizon AI agents that need diverse capabilities.
Introduces WeAct (Weight-level Internal Actions) to dynamically switch between independent capabilities during execution.
Overcomes limitations of static parameter configurations used in conventional joint training and adapter merging.

stories.title: LatComm: Reusable Context Compression for Latent Communication between Large Language Models
stories.author: Weijie Zhao
bullet_points: Addresses the inefficiency of repeatedly processing large, shared contexts when chaining multiple LLMs.
Introduces LatComm, a method designed for compact and reusable context representation between different LLMs.
Aims to solve the computational cost associated with passing large text contexts across multi-LLM systems.

stories.title: Agent World Model in the Wild: Computer-Use Agent Environment Synthesis
stories.author: Huaxiu Yao
bullet_points: Introduces WildAWM, a pipeline to synthesize controllable environments for training computer-use agents (CUAs).
Addresses the challenge of scaling agent learning from human data to real-world interaction without introducing security risks.
Represents a shift in agent learning methodology from relying solely on human data to learning through environmental interaction.

stories.title: KEEP-Bench: Evaluating Evidence Preservation in Context Compression
stories.author: Nanyun Peng
bullet_points: Introduces KEEP-Bench, a new diagnostic benchmark for evaluating evidence preservation in context compression.
Addresses the limitation of existing QA metrics, which fail to detect faithfulness loss during compression.
Tests compression faithfulness across 4,102 cases in challenging scenarios requiring evidence retention.

stories.title: RefCraft: Benchmarking Visual-Reference-Conditioned Agentic Generation through Web Development
stories.author: Shuai Bai
bullet_points: The research introduces 'RefCraft' to benchmark AI agentic generation that incorporates visual references.
The study uses webpage development as a practical, real-world setting to test this capability.
It highlights a gap in existing benchmarks, which often neglect the common workflow of integrating visual context beyond simple text-to-web generation.

stories.title: MemT-1.0: Towards Memory-Native Evolution
stories.author: Feiyu Xiong
bullet_points: Introduces MemT-1.0, a new architecture for memory foundation models designed to internalize memory as a core computational capability.
Employs Gated DeltaNet-2 and a stable token-level memory update mechanism to enable continuous information accumulation.
Features Mixture-of-Storage to address and scale the native memory capacity of the models.

stories.title: DeepInfer: High-performance inference framework for DeepSeek models
stories.author: ggcr
bullet_points: DeepInfer is a new high-performance inference framework.
It is specifically designed to optimize inference for DeepSeek models.
The release targets improving the speed and efficiency of large language model deployment.

stories.title: Your agent's retry bug isn't an AI problem. It's a distributed-systems problem with an LLM on top.
stories.author: cyclopt_dimitrisk
bullet_points: The article argues that common failures in AI agents (like retry bugs) stem from underlying distributed systems issues, not the LLM itself.
It critiques the typical 'happy path' demonstration of AI agents, which ignores real-world failure modes.
The piece suggests that robust agent development requires addressing complex system interactions beyond simple LLM prompting.

stories.title: Stress-Testing Gemini 4 Argon: Building a 3D Flutter Kart Game in 15 Prompts with Zero Assets
stories.author: leehack
bullet_points: The article explores using frontier AI models (like Gemini 4 Argon) for complex, non-standard coding tasks.
It demonstrates the capability of AI to build a 3D Flutter game using only text prompts (15 prompts, zero assets).
The piece highlights a gap in current AI coding benchmarks, which often focus only on basic web apps or CRUD operations.
